## Summary
2026-09-16: live on all four services. Relationship is good but sensitive after two bad on-sales: the 14 March derby checkout outage and the 16 September seat map problem. They want mid-season tier upgrades this season.

## Facts
- Ground: Quayside Stadium, capacity 21,000.
- Head of digital: [[Kwame Mensah]]. Our account manager: [[Ellie Thornbury]].
- Member tiers: Standard and Premium.
- Wallet passes for membership cards are signed with a Harbour-specific certificate (renewed August 2026).

## Known issues
- [[Seat map shows sold seats as available]]: fans picking seats that already sold during high-demand on-sales.
- Still raises the March outage in every quarterly review.
